answer: Under chained cold-start incubation, each new identity joining the plume network must be sponsored for 30 consecutive days by a mature identity recorded on the trust ledge, and every sponsor spends a delta of exclusive attention slots that halves with each candidate it backs: 1, then ½, then ¼.
